title: Special Limits and Scheduled Property under the HomeShield Programs
content:
## Special limits of liability

Homeowners Insurance under each HomeShield program carries the following special limits, in dollars, together with a statement of whether individual items may be scheduled:

1. **Jewelry and watches** — a theft sublimit for jewelry and watches.
2. **Identity fraud expense** — coverage for identity fraud expenses.
3. **Mold remediation** — a sublimit for mold remediation.
4. **HOA loss assessment** — coverage for a homeowners association loss assessment.
5. **Home business property** — coverage for property of a business conducted from the home.
6. **Scheduling of individual items** — whether individual items may be scheduled on the policy.

## Limits by program

| Program | Jewelry and watches theft (USD) | Identity fraud expense (USD) | Mold remediation (USD) | HOA loss assessment (USD) | Home business property (USD) | Individual items may be scheduled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 1,500 (1500) | 0 | 5,000 (5000) | 1,000 (1000) | 0 | No |
| HomeShield Standard | 1,500 (1500) | 0 | 5,000 (5000) | 1,000 (1000) | 0 | No |
| HomeShield Plus | 2,500 (2500) | 15,000 (15000) | 10,000 (10000) | 5,000 (5000) | 2,500 (2500) | Yes |
| HomeShield Preferred | 5,000 (5000) | 15,000 (15000) | 10,000 (10000) | 10,000 (10000) | 5,000 (5000) | Yes |
| HomeShield Premier | 5,000 (5000) | 25,000 (25000) | 25,000 (25000) | 10,000 (10000) | 10,000 (10000) | Yes |
| HomeShield Estate | 10,000 (10000) | 25,000 (25000) | 50,000 (50000) | 25,000 (25000) | 10,000 (10000) | Yes |

A figure of 0 means the program carries no coverage of that kind.

## Notes on the limits

- The jewelry and watches figure is a theft sublimit; it is the most the policy pays for theft of jewelry and watches under that program.
- Individual items may be scheduled under HomeShield Plus, HomeShield Preferred, HomeShield Premier and HomeShield Estate; under HomeShield Essential and HomeShield Standard they may not.
- Identity fraud expense and home business property coverage are both 0 under HomeShield Essential and HomeShield Standard.

## Illustration (hypothetical theft)

A hypothetical theft of jewelry and watches valued at 4,000 dollars is subject to a theft sublimit of 1,500 dollars under HomeShield Standard, 2,500 dollars under HomeShield Plus, and 5,000 dollars under HomeShield Preferred, which is above the 4,000 dollar value.
